master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE complete original commercial-game vehicle sprite facing RIGHT, premium semi-realistic painted illustration, readable dark contours, rich weathered natural textures and fine mechanical detail. Soft even daylight. Orange boxy amphibious skid-steer four-wheel-drive vehicle on FOUR enormous low-pressure balloon tyres, two visible near side wheels. Flat roof, front door, roof rack, spot lamps. Compact boat-like hull with river mud. NO LOAD.3.4m long tyre diameter1.6m. Exactly TWO axles. Two enormous near side wheels nearly tyre to tyre and support whole hull. Cab shape is explicitly a flat-front amphibious utility cabin, no conventional truck bonnet. Road tyres: huge low-pressure flotation balloon tyre with broad paddle lugs, compact steel rim. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, every tyre a perfect circle of the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. All road tyres fully visible, all hubs exactly one horizontal line, wheels fit centred round arches with natural clearance. Mechanically plausible cab: visible bonnet if conventional truck; distinct bonnet, radiator housing, headlamp, blunt bumper and round front fender with clean seams, no pointed wedge or fused shapes. Correctly scaled rectangular mirror on short rigid brackets beside A-pillar, no tangles or floating equipment. NO visible front grille face, NO three-quarter camera, only sliver of roof, level chassis and load. Original designs only, no real make or model shape copied, no badges, text, logos, emblems, watermarks, brand or sponsor marks. No snow chains, no ground or shadows, no checkerboard or colored halos. True transparent background, clean alpha in every gap, full vehicle with generous margins. Use natural full length; never compress the rig. PNG at least 1760px wide, detailed high resolution. CRITICAL FRAMING: entire vehicle, complete load and round tyre bottoms inside CENTRAL80% of canvas. Large transparent border all sides. Nothing cut off. MOST IMPORTANT: there must be REAL ALPHA transparency everywhere outside the machine, absolutely no opaque brown glow, no vignette or studio backdrop. The box hull is only about TWO TYRE DIAMETERS long: 3.4m hull over TWO 1.6m diameter near-side wheels, tyres almost touching, huge tyres spanning nearly the full hull length. Very compact machine, tall square utilitarian cabin and small hull overhangs. Not an elongated truck. Absolute side elevation with no visible front face.

wheel.prompt: Reference role: ROAD wheels on attached master. Generate ONE matching huge low-pressure flotation balloon tyre with broad paddle lugs, compact steel rim. Match weathering, rim and hub design. Absolutely circular tyre and concentric rim, hub EXACTLY centred on square transparent canvas with equal generous clear margins. Face-on side elevation, soft even daylight suitable for rotating sprite. Premium semi-realistic painted illustration, fine mechanical detail, natural dark contours. No body, axle, text, brands, badges, logos, chains, background, ground, shadow, checkerboard or halo. Native square PNG.

method: Built-in image generator. Generated body registered and masked inside measured road-wheel regions; unchanged non-wheel master pixels retained. Generated wheel silhouette circularized. Native painting retained without upscaling. Measurements and correction parameters in validation.json.

rejected_attempts.reason: Opaque backdrop and tyres too small; regenerated with compact hull and larger tyres.
